decision_summary: crates.io still has no h3 newer than 0.0.8 and no h3-quinn newer than 0.0.10. PR #339 remains open and unreleased, so #338 stays a graduation blocker. Workspace Quinn pins were refreshed after RUSTSEC-2026-0523 / 0524 / 0538; that bump does not clear #338.

crates_io_observed.notes: A Quinn-only bump does not fix h3 #338. No h3/h3-quinn upgrade is taken in this hygiene refresh.

advisories.notes: Resolved quinn-proto 0.11.19 is past the patched floor.
MAX_STREAM_DATA stream-limit OOM; patched floor is 0.11.19. Workspace pin matches.
Long Retry token panic/OOM on clients; patched floor is 0.11.19. Workspace pin matches.
Truncated-datagram receive spin on some platforms; patched floors include 0.5.16. Workspace pin matches.

issues.title: FrameStream discards buffered bytes when QUIC connection error arrives in the same recv batch
issues.impact_on_successful_response: A complete response can surface as a connection error when STREAM data and CONNECTION_CLOSE coalesce. No eggfetch workaround exists on the response-header path because only h3 holds the buffered frames.
issues.existing_tests: Local early-close / graceful-close suites distinguish EOF from error but do not reliably reproduce the coalesced-batch race.

issues.title: frame: drain buffered bytes before propagating QUIC connection error
issues.impact_on_successful_response: Unreleased fix. Cannot be adopted without a published crate or a forbidden fork/vendor.

issues.title: h3-quinn stop_sending during outstanding read deferred; peer may see STOP_SENDING(0)
issues.impact_on_successful_response: Does not corrupt ordinary successful responses. Cancellation remains usable in eggfetch tests; conformant STOP_SENDING wire codes during a pending read are not claimed.
issues.existing_tests: h3_hardening / h3_interop cancellation suites assert prompt return and a usable client afterwards, not wire codes.
issues.graduation_scope: blocks any claim of conformant STOP_SENDING wire codes during a pending read; does not by itself corrupt an ordinary successful response body

issues.title: Request reset cannot be observed independently while body polling is paused
eggfetch_paths: server-side observation of client RESET while application backpressure pauses poll_data; ordinary client GET/POST recv path still polls
issues.impact_on_successful_response: Does not turn a complete client response into an error by itself. Affects reset observability under backpressure.
issues.existing_tests: Local stream_reset / early-close recovery tests; no independent reset-poll API in eggfetch.

issues.title: AsyncWrite reduces typed stream failures to io::ErrorKind::Other
eggfetch_paths: eggfetch uses typed h3 poll paths, not the AsyncWrite adapter, for ordinary H3 request/response
issues.impact_on_successful_response: None on the ordinary eggfetch client path.

drain_api.notes: Still required for GOAWAY draining in transport/http3.rs. Re-audit on any h3 bump.

m010_implication: M010 cannot clear the upstream graduation row while #338/#339 remain unreleased. #361 remains an open cancellation wire-code limitation outside any supported cancellation claim. M012 hygiene refresh aligns Quinn pins with workspace Cargo.lock only.
m012_notes: Nested qualification/embedded/*/Cargo.lock trees are separate evidence graphs; scripts/check_security.sh scans the workspace root lock only unless an operator runs a named embed evidence refresh.
